Provider and implementation reference: https://support.atlassian.com/bitbucket-cloud/
files.README.md:
# Atlassian Bitbucket

Open the built-in Bitbucket token setup from Talia Store. Configure the instance and token in Talia. Scope access to selected repositories. Data Center uses a personal access token. Installing this reference records the package without opening a connection.

[Provider and implementation reference](https://support.atlassian.com/bitbucket-cloud/)

packages.description_it: Collega Bitbucket Cloud o Data Center con un token, limita l’accesso ai repository selezionati e scegli tra sola lettura e lettura e scrittura.
